name: The Gentlemen's Club: Obscene Material
source:
Your publishing company is shaken when a naughty pamphlet crosses your desk. The stories are full of debauchery and sex... but the author? He's brilliant. Stephen Sweete has a gift. And he needs your help. In exchange for your services, Stephen will write you a perfectly respectable novel. But can you keep this arrangement strictly professional?

[From in-app]
